Monaer brake parts: questions and answers

Short answers for drivers and workshops.

WhatsApp
What is special about Monaer brake pads?

They use a nano ceramic material: quieter, low dust and stable when hot. Every set also comes with a fitting kit of cleaner spray, gloves and anti-noise grease.

How are they different from the pads my car came with?

Factory pads cover basic use. Monaer says its nano ceramic pads give more consistent braking, less noise and less dust in city traffic and daily driving.

Nano ceramic or semi-metallic?

Semi-metallic pads make more dark dust. Nano ceramic pads are cleaner and quieter, which suits daily driving.

How much heat can they take?

Monaer lists heat fade resistance from 600°C, and 800°C on its performance pads. Ask us for the figure for your part.

How do I check if Monaer fits my car?

Use the part finder or send us your car on WhatsApp. We confirm model, size and spec before you buy.

Do you have brake discs and brake fluid too?

Yes. Monaer has coated high-carbon discs and DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 brake fluid.

Do you deliver outside Johor?

Ask us on WhatsApp with your town and we tell you the options.

How can my workshop stock Monaer?

Apply on the For workshops page. We reply on WhatsApp with the next steps.

Product details on this site are as published by Monaer Brake System Malaysia. Ask us for the details of your exact part.

How to get Monaer pads for your car

  1. 1

    Send your car details

    Make, model, year and engine on WhatsApp. A photo of your road tax or the old pad helps.

  2. 2

    We match the part

    We check the Monaer catalogue number against your car's original part number.

  3. 3

    Fit at a workshop

    Collect from us in Skudai or have it fitted at a Monaer workshop near you.
